drampower.role: optional LPDDR core-energy sensitivity only; not a primary H3 result contributor

edge_lpddr_platform_envelope.role: public edge-class LPDDR capacity/bandwidth envelope; not an emulation target

fio_storage_tool.role: primary measured real-storage calibration with deterministic spatial windows, repeated runs, randomized order, and achieved-QD qualification

lpddr_absolute_energy.role: not a primary H3 claim; DRAMPower can provide a secondary core-only datasheet envelope

mqsim.role: pinned optional future SSD-model sensitivity; not used for the primary measured H3 result

offline_conventional_bound.method: service-time-optimized static frequency bound with resident footprint separated from lower-tier transfer footprint
offline_conventional_bound.role: strong conventional static oracle using measured storage + LPDDR fill service cost

promotion_prerequisites.deployment_capacity: contract-fixed 32-GiB platform minus non-negative SHA-bound reservations
promotion_prerequisites.long_context_beyond_8k: derived trace-valid multi-length characterization with distinct 8K, 16K, and 32K context bands
promotion_prerequisites.placement_invariance: ordered PLE/routing semantic identity across at least two physical-placement controls; timing metadata may differ
promotion_prerequisites.storage_qd32_sufficiency: raw workload-derived scheduler events with observed outstanding I/O and object-specific prefetch slack; FENIX derives >=75% QD utilization and >=75% completion-within-slack thresholds

ramulator_lpddr5_profile.actual_trace_calibration: policy/stratum/capacity/phase-specific logical read/fill trace derived from H3 residency under dense-first-touch and hashed-bank-spread collision-free sample-local layouts
ramulator_lpddr5_profile.promotion_semantics: high-MLP service-oracle envelope across nCS and multiple injective address-layout sensitivities; no mapping is claimed to preserve the original >32-GiB physical address geometry
ramulator_lpddr5_profile.role: mature device/controller model used for a deliberately optimistic high-MLP service envelope; 16-channel scale-up is explicit

storage_absolute_energy.role: unresolved; no H3 energy-superiority claim allowed

storage_latency_bandwidth.role: QD1/QD8 are diagnostic; QD32 is an optimistic gap-falsification point. Conventional sufficiency additionally requires workload-derived measured scheduler evidence that QD32 is realizable.
storage_latency_bandwidth.source: measured locally by pinned fio against the resolved backing device

storage_uncertainty.method: non-overlapping complete-request blocks; PLE/expert/mixed iologs are filters of the same block; hierarchical joint bootstrap resamples a paired block then physical repeats
storage_uncertainty.role: prevent pseudo-replication from population-limited/class-specific windows and propagate paired block/run variability
